verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Unstructured serves an llms.txt at docs.unstructured.io/llms.txt. The docs also include a dedicated agent guide that tells agents to prefer MCP server, then SDK, then API, and docs pages are available as raw .md files that agents can consume directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
